title: Orientation programme for new B.Tech IT and M.Tech IT students
content: All newly admitted students of PROG-BTECH-IT-001 (Semester I) and PROG-MTECH-IT-001 (Semester I) must attend the orientation programme from 13 to 15 July 2026 in the IT Seminar Hall (FCL-IT-001, Demo Innovation Block B, Room DB-201). Sessions cover the curriculum, laboratory rules (POLICY-002, POLICY-003) and student services.

title: Odd semester course registration window
content: Course registration for the odd semester of AY 2026-2027 is open from 6 to 10 July 2026. Semester V students must select one course each from ELECTIVE-I (EGRP-BTECH-IT-05-ELECTIVE-I) and ELECTIVE-II (EGRP-BTECH-IT-05-ELECTIVE-II). Queries: Department Office (FCL-IT-010).

title: Odd semester timetable published
content: The odd semester timetable for B.Tech IT Semesters III, V and VII and M.Tech IT Semesters I and III is published. Practicals for 2CEIT303 DATABASE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM run in LAB-IT-003 (Room DA-303); practicals for 2CEIT503 COMPUTER NETWORKS run in LAB-IT-005 (Room DA-401).

title: Capstone project team formation and topic registration
content: Students of 2CEIT504 CAPSTONE PROJECT-I (Semester V) and 2CEIT703 CAPSTONE PROJECT-III (Semester VII) must form teams of 2–4 and register titles with the Project Coordinator Dr. Leena Projectkar (FAC-IT-020) by 14 August 2026 as per POLICY-004.

title: Mid-semester examination schedule – odd semester (version 1)
content: Mid-semester examinations for the odd semester will be held from 7 to 12 September 2026. Detailed paper-wise timetable is attached to this notice. This notice is SUPERSEDED by NOTICE-008.

title: Independence Day holiday
content: The department will remain closed on 15 August 2026 (CAL-2026-27-005). Laboratories LAB-IT-001 to LAB-IT-010 will be closed.

title: Hands-on workshop: Retrieval-Augmented Generation with local SLMs
content: A one-day workshop on retrieval-augmented generation, BM25 + vector hybrid search and local small language models will be conducted by Dr. Nisha Tokenwala (FAC-IT-003) in the Natural Language Processing Lab (LAB-IT-002, Room DA-302) on 29 August 2026. Recommended for students of 2CEIT78PE7 NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING and 3CEIT307.

title: REVISED mid-semester examination schedule – odd semester (version 2)
content: This notice supersedes NOTICE-005. The mid-semester examination window remains 7 to 12 September 2026, but the 2CEIT602 ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE paper for re-registered students moves to 12 September 2026 (Saturday) and all papers now start at 10:00 instead of 09:30.

title: Weekly lab slot registration opens for Database Systems Lab and Programming Lab
content: Extra practice slots in LAB-IT-003 (Database Systems Lab) and LAB-IT-004 (Programming Lab) can be registered every Monday from 09:00 by email to it-labs@campusmate-demo.example, as per POLICY-002.

title: Guest seminar: Responsible AI in education
content: A guest seminar on responsible AI in education will be held on 16 September 2026 at 11:00 in the IT Seminar Hall (FCL-IT-001). Coordinated by Dr. Arjun Tensorkar (FAC-IT-002).

title: Faculty meeting – capstone mid-review panels
content: All IT faculty members are requested to attend a meeting on 15 September 2026 at 15:00 in the Faculty Lounge (FCL-IT-004) to finalise panels for the capstone mid-review (CAL-2026-27-007) under POLICY-005. Convened by the Head of Department, Dr. Meera Datavala (FAC-IT-001).

title: Capstone mid-review schedule
content: Capstone Project mid-reviews for 2CEIT504 and 2CEIT703 will run from 28 September to 3 October 2026 in the Capstone Project Room (FCL-IT-002, Room DA-205). Teams must upload an interim report 48 hours before their slot (POLICY-004, POLICY-005).

title: GPU Computing Facility maintenance
content: The GPU Computing Facility (FCL-IT-008, Room DA-405) will be unavailable on 19–20 September 2026 for scheduled maintenance. Jobs queued before 18 September 18:00 will be resumed afterwards.

title: Timetable update: Cloud Computing and Big Data Analytics practicals
content: From 21 September 2026, practicals of 2CEIT702 BIG DATA ANALYTICS move from Wednesday to Friday 14:00–16:00 in LAB-IT-006 (Cloud & Big Data Lab, Room DA-402).

title: Summer internship report submission (AY 2025-2026 carry-over)
content: Students who completed optional summer internships must submit a 2-page report to the Department Office (FCL-IT-010) by 31 July 2026. This notice has EXPIRED.

title: Mandatory safety induction for IoT & Robotics Lab
content: Students intending to take 2CEIT6PE6 ROBOTICS or 2CEIT6PE9 INTERNET OF THINGS, and M.Tech students of 3CEIT305, must complete the safety induction in LAB-IT-007 (Room DB-101) as per POLICY-003.

title: M.Tech Major Project Part - I supervisor allocation
content: Supervisor allocation for 3CEIT301 MAJOR PROJECT PART - I is published. Students must submit research proposals by the end of week 4 as per POLICY-010. Contact the Project Coordinator (FAC-IT-020).

title: End-semester examination form submission
content: Examination forms for the odd semester end-semester examinations (CAL-2026-27-012, 30 November to 12 December 2026) must be submitted between 21 September and 9 October 2026 via the Department Office (FCL-IT-010).

title: Department reading room extended hours
content: The Department Reading Room (FCL-IT-009, Room DA-209) will remain open until 21:00 on weekdays until the end of the odd semester examinations.

title: Seminar topic approval deadline for M.Tech SEMINAR (3CEIT302)
content: M.Tech Semester III students must get seminar topics approved by 21 August 2026 as per POLICY-007. Seminars will be delivered in the IT Seminar Hall (FCL-IT-001).
